method: Steam top sellers with Mac builds + multiplayer (store API), SteamSpy top 100, plus non-Steam Mac games; each checked by web research (wikis, official pages, Steam/AppleGamingWiki). Unconfirmed details are marked '(check in game)'.

games.name: Total War: WARHAMMER III
games.note: No in-game text chat; Creative Assembly removed it in this game. Use Steam chat instead.

games.name: Magic: The Gathering Arena
games.note: Opponents can only be sent emotes. Free text works only in direct messages with friends, opened by clicking the social panel (check in game).

games.name: Dota 2
games.note: Chat opens with Enter (Shift+Enter for all chat). On Mac, Dota 2 chat has ignored Cmd+V and only pasted with Ctrl+V, so Aura's paste may not land (check in game).

games.name: MapleStory
games.rules_risk: Nexon's rules ban macro and third-party input programs (check in game)
games.note: Chat opens with Enter; press it, then dictate. The Mac version is a beta for Apple Silicon, and paste support is unconfirmed (check in game).

games.name: Crusader Kings III
games.note: No built-in multiplayer text chat; players use Steam chat or a Workshop chat mod.

games.note: The Mac version has not been able to connect to online play on macOS 14 and later, and it no longer matches with Windows players (check in game).

games.name: Euro Truck Simulator 2
